# Repositories the threatflux-automation GitHub App serves, one per line.
#
# This list is the single source of truth for three settings that must stay
# identical:
#   - the repositories the App installation on ThreatFlux can access;
#   - the selected repositories of the TF_AUTOMATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
#     organization secret;
#   - the selected repositories of the TF_AUTOMATION_APP_ID organization
#     variable.
# automation-app-health.yml fails when any of them differs from this list, in
# either direction, and scripts/rotate-automation-app-key.sh shares the secret
# (and, with --sync-repos, the variable) with exactly these repositories.
# Change the list in the same pull request that adds or removes a repository,
# then update the three settings to match. Runbook: docs/SECRETS-ROTATION.md.
#
# Repository names only (no owner). Blank lines and comments are ignored.

FluxEncrypt
FluxPrompt
anthropic_rust_sdk
file-scanner
gguf
github_actions
ollama_rust_sdk
openai_rust_sdk
rust-cicd-template
threatflux-atlassian
threatflux-binary-analysis
threatflux-cache
threatflux-hashing
threatflux-package-security
threatflux-string-analysis
threatflux-threat-detection
threatflux-unifi-sdk
vertex_rust_sdk
virustotal-rs
yrlint
